stem.flightsim.start_step_lesson: Learn how a wing makes lift
stem.flightsim.start_step_landing: Land on a runway at an airport
stem.flightsim.start_step_mission: Complete a rescue or drone mission
stem.flightsim.hint_t_low_power: ⚠️ Low and sinking: drag UP on the right edge for power, then ease the nose up gently.
stem.flightsim.hint_k_low_power: ⚠️ Low and sinking: add power (+ or Shift), then raise the nose gently.
stem.flightsim.toast_distress_beacon_v2: 🚁 Distress beacon: a boater in Casco Bay, {distance} nm away. Lift off, fly heading {heading}°, recover the survivor.
stem.flightsim.hud_key_legend_v2: W/S: Pitch | A/D: Bank | +/−: Power | V: View | Q: Quiz | F: Forces | Space: Pause | ?: Help
stem.flightsim.challenge_controls_hint_v: Cockpit controls: W/S pitch, A/D bank, +/− power, Space pause.
stem.flightsim.rotor_cockpit_label_v2: Rotorcraft flight display. W/S move forward or back, A/D move sideways, Q/E turn the nose, + and − rotor power, Space pause, I info.
stem.flightsim.flight_simulator_cockpit_: Flight simulator cockpit view. W/S pitch, A/D steer on the ground or bank in flight, + and − throttle, brackets control flaps, X wheel brakes, Q quiz, F forces, Space pause, I info.
stem.flightsim.nav_next_discovery_status: Next discovery: {place}. Bearing {bearing} degrees, {distance} nautical miles away.
stem.flightsim.challenge_controls_touch: Touch controls: drag up/down from the middle to pitch, sideways to bank, and along the far right edge to change power. Use Pause to stop.
stem.flightsim.challenge_climb_coaching_: Use W/S for small pitch changes and +/− for power. Climb toward {alt} ft MSL, then ease the nose down to level off.
Drag gently up/down from the middle to pitch; use the far right edge for power. Climb toward {alt} ft MSL, then ease the nose down to level off.
stem.flightsim.challenge_hold_coaching: Level the wings and use small pitch and power changes to keep vertical speed near zero. Hold the target altitude until the timer finishes.
stem.flightsim.challenge_landing_coachin: Return toward a runway. Reduce power with − and use W/S for small pitch changes. Aim for about {speed} kts IAS; just above the runway, gently raise the nose to slow the descent.

Return toward a runway. Drag down along the far right edge to reduce power; drag gently up/down from the middle to pitch. Aim for about {speed} kts IAS, then gently raise the nose just above the runway.
stem.flightsim.challenge_brakes_keys: Press X to release the wheel brakes before adding power.
stem.flightsim.challenge_brakes_touch: Open Deck and release Wheel Brakes before adding power.
